custom_tools.name: save_working_context
custom_tools.description: Save a working set (explicit task plus host-provided files and symbol selections) as a compact inline lci context manifest. Returns references and intent only; no source is read. Rejects malformed, contradictory or empty sets and sets above 128 references.

task.description: Explicit task the working set is for.

files.description: Host-provided working set: open or recently-read files, each with optional symbol selections, semantic role and expansion intent.

path.description: File path as the host knows it.

symbols.description: Selected symbols in the file; omitted or empty means a file-only reference.

role.description: Semantic role carried onto every reference for this file (e.g. modify, contract, verify).

expand.description: Expansion directives carried onto every reference for this file (e.g. callers, callees).

max_tokens.description: Accepted for symmetry with open/resume/refresh; save returns a reference-only manifest and performs no load.

custom_tools.name: open_files_context
custom_tools.description: Build a working set from the host's open/recently-read files and active symbol selections, then resolve it through lci in one shared-budget load. Returns the single hydrated context result. The caller must ensure indexing has finished; indexing or unavailable errors are surfaced, not masked, and the result is not a claim of on-disk freshness.

task.description: Explicit task the working set is for.

files.description: Host-provided working set: open or recently-read files, each with optional symbol selections, semantic role and expansion intent.

path.description: File path as the host knows it.

symbols.description: Selected symbols in the file; omitted or empty means a file-only reference.

role.description: Semantic role carried onto every reference for this file (e.g. modify, contract, verify).

expand.description: Expansion directives carried onto every reference for this file (e.g. callers, callees).

max_tokens.description: Shared token budget for the single load (default 8000).

custom_tools.name: resume_working_context
custom_tools.description: Resume a saved working-context manifest by hydrating it against the current index in one shared-budget load. Returns the single hydrated context result; indexing or unavailable errors are surfaced.

manifest.description: A working-context manifest string previously returned by save_working_context or open_files_context.

max_tokens.description: Shared token budget for the single load (default 8000).

custom_tools.name: refresh_working_context
custom_tools.description: Refresh a working-context manifest by re-resolving its references against the current index (cached fields such as source, stats and project root are dropped). Use after edits once indexing has finished; returns one shared-budget context result and surfaces indexing/unavailable errors.

manifest.description: A working-context manifest string previously returned by save_working_context or open_files_context.

max_tokens.description: Shared token budget for the single load (default 8000).
